references.text: The prophet Isaiah predicts that the Messiah will bear our diseases and sorrows, which parallels Simon of Cyrene carrying Jesus' cross.
Matthew also describes the event where Simon of Cyrene is forced to carry Jesus' cross.
Luke also mentions Simon of Cyrene who carried the cross for Jesus.
John notes that Jesus carried his own cross, but this can be seen in connection with the other Gospels that tell about Simon of Cyrene.
